plugins.name: topology-cartographer
plugins.description: Ask your codebase an architecture question and get the one diagram that answers it, with a file:line receipt on every arrow. Zero runtime: pure Markdown instructions your agent follows with its own search and read tools - no Python, no MCP server. Maps Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, NATS and Pub/Sub bindings, REST/gRPC/GraphQL calls and datastores into a diffable ledger, then draws focus, lineage, path, impact, diff or review views in Mermaid (draw.io on request). Read-only on the analysed code.
